english_text: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
english:
Challenges are brief, and they offer an opportunity for growth.
Through perseverance, we become more capable and confident.
In time, this process steadies and strengthens us.
spanish:
Los desafíos son breves y ofrecen una oportunidad para crecer.
A través de la perseverancia, nos volvemos más capaces y seguros.
Con el tiempo, este proceso nos estabiliza y nos fortalece.
portuguese:
Os desafios são breves e oferecem uma oportunidade de crescimento.
Através da perseverança, tornamo-nos mais capazes e confiantes.
Com o tempo, esse processo nos estabiliza e nos fortalece.
french:
Les défis sont brefs et offrent une occasion de grandir.
Par la persévérance, nous devenons plus capables et confiants.
Avec le temps, ce processus nous stabilise et nous renforce.
tagalog:
Ang mga hamon ay panandalian at nag-aalok ng pagkakataon para sa paglago.
Sa pamamagitan ng pagtitiyaga, nagiging mas may kakayahan at tiwala tayo.
Sa paglipas ng panahon, pinatatag at pinapantay ng prosesong ito ang ating sarili.
swahili:
Changamoto ni za muda mfupi, na zinatoa fursa ya kukua.
Kupitia uvumilivu, tunakuwa na uwezo zaidi na kujiamini.
Kwa muda, mchakato huu hutuliza na kutuimarisha.
mandarin_chinese:
挑战是短暂的，它们提供了成长的机会。
通过坚持不懈，我们变得更有能力和自信。
随着时间的推移，这一过程会使我们更加稳固和强大。
russian:
Испытания кратковременны и предоставляют возможность для роста.
Через настойчивость мы становимся более способными и уверенными.
Со временем этот процесс стабилизирует и укрепляет нас.
malayalam:
ചവിട്ടുകൾ ചെറുതാണ്, അവ വളർച്ചയുടെ അവസരം നൽകുന്നു.
സ്ഥൈര്യത്തോടെ, നാം കൂടുതൽ കഴിവുള്ളവരും ആത്മവിശ്വാസമുള്ളവരും ആകുന്നു.
കാലക്രമേണ, ഈ പ്രക്രിയ നമ്മെ സ്ഥിരതയുള്ളതും ശക്തവുമാക്കുന്നു.
